dead_edge.name: Dead Edge
dead_edge.desc_en: +52 Damage. 25% chance to Critical Strike (200% damage).
dead_edge.flavor: Tebasan maut yang berdentang di ujung setiap medan tempur.

holy_rapier.name: Holy Rapier
holy_rapier.desc: +120 Damage. HILANG saat hero mati (tidak dijatuhkan).
holy_rapier.desc_en: +120 Damage. LOST when the hero dies (not dropped).
holy_rapier.flavor: Kilau cahaya yang hanya pantas dipegang oleh yang hidup.

demon_maw.name: Demon Maw
demon_maw.desc: +20 Damage, +4 Armor, 20% Lifesteal. Saat HP < 35%: aktif Blood Frenzy, lifesteal 140% selama 5 detik.
demon_maw.desc_en: +20 Damage, +4 Armor, 20% Lifesteal. Below 35% HP: Blood Frenzy activates, 140% lifesteal for 5 seconds.
demon_maw.flavor: Topeng iblis yang lapar akan darah lawan.

leviathan_heart.name: Leviathan Heart
leviathan_heart.desc: +35% Max HP, +6 HP/reg. Di luar pertempuran (5 dtk tanpa damage): regenerasi 1.5% Max HP per detik.
leviathan_heart.desc_en: +35% Max HP, +6 HP regen. Out of combat (5s without damage): regenerate 1.5% Max HP per second.
leviathan_heart.flavor: Jantung purba yang berdegup menyamai lautan.

cleave_axe.name: Cleave Axe
cleave_axe.desc: +34 Damage, +3 HP/reg. Serangan melee membelah: 50% damage ke musuh dalam radius 110 (hanya melee).
cleave_axe.desc_en: +34 Damage, +3 HP regen. Melee attacks cleave: 50% damage to enemies within 110 radius (melee only).
cleave_axe.flavor: Kapak berukir yang menebas apapun di depannya.

steel_aegis.name: Steel Aegis
steel_aegis.desc: +4 Armor, +30 Attack Speed. Aura: sekutu di dekat dapat +2 Armor & +10 AS; musuh di dekat kehilangan 2 Armor.
steel_aegis.desc_en: +4 Armor, +30 Attack Speed. Aura: nearby allies gain +2 Armor & +10 AS; nearby enemies lose 2 Armor.
steel_aegis.flavor: Zirah baja yang berdenyut memberi semangat kawan.

moon_shard.name: Moon Shard
moon_shard.desc: +75 Attack Speed. Serangan secepat cahaya bulan.
moon_shard.desc_en: +75 Attack Speed. Strikes as fast as moonlight.
moon_shard.flavor: Serpihan rembulan yang membeku jadi kristal.

octarine_core.name: Octarine Core
octarine_core.desc: +300 HP, +2 HP/reg, 15% Cooldown Reduction, 10% Spell Lifesteal (heal = 10% damage skill yang dikeluarkan).
octarine_core.desc_en: +300 HP, +2 HP regen, 15% Cooldown Reduction, 10% Spell Lifesteal (heal = 10% of skill damage dealt).
octarine_core.flavor: Inti ungu yang berputar dengan kekuatan arcane.

scarlet_bulwark.name: Scarlet Bulwark
scarlet_bulwark.desc: +250 HP, +8 HP/reg, +6 Armor. Blok pasif 55% (25 dmg). Saat HP < 45%: Guard 7 dtk, kamu & sekutu dekat blokir 35+2% Max HP per serangan.
scarlet_bulwark.desc_en: +250 HP, +8 HP regen, +6 Armor. Passive block 55% (25 dmg). Below 45% HP: Guard for 7s, you & nearby allies block 35 + 2% Max HP per attack.
scarlet_bulwark.flavor: Perisai kirmizi penahan amukan Tahun Kegelapan.

monarch_wings.name: Monarch Wings
monarch_wings.desc: +38 Damage, +30 Attack Speed, 28% Evasion (peluang menghindari serangan fisik sepenuhnya).
monarch_wings.desc_en: +38 Damage, +30 Attack Speed, 28% Evasion (chance to fully dodge physical attacks).
monarch_wings.flavor: Sayap raja kupu-kupu yang menolak setiap bilah.

corroder.name: Corroder
corroder.desc: +65 Damage. Serangan mengikis 6 Armor target selama 6 detik (target menerima damage lebih besar).
corroder.desc_en: +65 Damage. Attacks shred 6 Armor from the target for 6 seconds (target takes more damage).
corroder.flavor: Bilah berkarat yang melarutkan zirah dan daging.

tempest_vane.name: Tempest Vane
tempest_vane.desc: +250 HP, +4 HP/reg, +12% Move Speed. Saat HP < 40%: kebal semua damage 2.5 dtk (tidak bisa menyerang), cooldown 30 dtk.
tempest_vane.desc_en: +250 HP, +4 HP regen, +12% Move Speed. Below 40% HP: immune to all damage for 2.5s (cannot attack), 30s cooldown.

fenrir_chain.name: Fenrir Chain
fenrir_chain.desc: +30 Damage, +30 AS, +250 HP. 20% serangan menyambar 3 musuh (45 dmg). Saat >=2 musuh dekat: rantai mengikat mereka 1.2 dtk + 80 dmg.
fenrir_chain.desc_en: +30 Damage, +30 AS, +250 HP. 20% of attacks chain to 3 enemies (45 dmg). When 2+ enemies are near: chains root them for 1.2s + 80 dmg.
fenrir_chain.flavor: Rantai para dewa yang membelenggu serigala purba.

sanguine_thorn.name: Sanguine Thorn
sanguine_thorn.desc: +25 Damage, +60 AS, +5 HP/reg. Soul Rend (auto): silence target 5 dtk, seranganmu ke target crit 150%, target menerima +30% damage.
sanguine_thorn.desc_en: +25 Damage, +60 AS, +5 HP regen. Soul Rend (auto): silences the target for 5s, your attacks on it crit for 150%, target takes +30% damage.
sanguine_thorn.flavor: Duri darah yang menagih nyawa setiap korbannya.

abyss_breaker.name: Abyss Breaker
abyss_breaker.desc: +35 Damage, +300 HP, +16% heal diterima, +30% tahan slow. Bash 22%: stun 0.9 dtk + 55 dmg. Overwhelm (auto): stun target 1.2 dtk.
abyss_breaker.desc_en: +35 Damage, +300 HP, +16% incoming heal, +30% slow resist. Bash 22%: stun 0.9s + 55 dmg. Overwhelm (auto): stuns the target for 1.2s.
abyss_breaker.flavor: Pedang Komandan Jurang yang memutus jiwa.

thunder_coil.name: Thunder Coil
thunder_coil.desc: +25 Damage, +65 AS. 22% serangan menyambar 3 musuh (40 dmg). Saat dipukul: 20% perisai statis 8 dtk, menyambar 4 musuh tiap 0.5 dtk (65 dmg).
thunder_coil.desc_en: +25 Damage, +65 AS. 22% of attacks chain to 3 enemies (40 dmg). When hit: 20% chance of a static shield for 8s, zapping 4 enemies every 0.5s (65 dmg).
thunder_coil.flavor: Kumparan badai yang ditempa palu dewa guntur.

razor_carapace.name: Razor Carapace
razor_carapace.desc: +18 Damage, +8 Armor, 10% CDR. Saat HP < 55%: Thornmail 4.5 dtk - pantulkan 85% damage yang kamu terima ke penyerang.
razor_carapace.desc_en: +18 Damage, +8 Armor, 10% CDR. Below 55% HP: Thornmail for 4.5s - reflect 85% of damage you take back to the attacker.
razor_carapace.flavor: Cangkang bergerigi yang membalas setiap luka.

everfrost_guard.name: Everfrost Guard
everfrost_guard.desc: +10 Armor, +5 HP/reg, 10% CDR. Aura: musuh dekat -30% AS & heal -40%. Saat >=2 musuh dekat: Arctic Blast 130 dmg + slow 45% (3.5 dtk).
everfrost_guard.desc_en: +10 Armor, +5 HP regen, 10% CDR. Aura: nearby enemies lose 30% AS & 40% healing. When 2+ enemies are near: Arctic Blast 130 dmg + 45% slow for 3.5s.
everfrost_guard.flavor: Bongkahan es abadi yang membekukan setiap denyut nadi.

sundering_cudgel.name: Sundering Cudgel
sundering_cudgel.desc: +45 Damage, +25 AS. Serangan TIDAK PERNAH meleset (True Strike). 28% serangan memukul mundir target: stun 0.25 dtk + 55 dmg (CD 2 dtk).
sundering_cudgel.desc_en: +45 Damage, +25 AS. Your attacks NEVER miss (True Strike). 28% of attacks bash the target: 0.25s stun + 55 dmg (2s cooldown).
sundering_cudgel.flavor: Tongkat pemukul legendaris yang menembus segala kilah.

frostbound_eye.name: Frostbound Eye
frostbound_eye.desc: +20 Damage, +250 HP, +4 HP/reg. Tiap serangan memperlambat 28% (gerak & serang) + anti-heal 45% selama 3 detik.
frostbound_eye.desc_en: +20 Damage, +250 HP, +4 HP regen. Each attack slows by 28% (move & attack) and applies 45% anti-heal for 3 seconds.
frostbound_eye.flavor: Mata es yang membekukan darah di setiap luka.

gale_pike.name: Gale Pike
gale_pike.desc: +18 Damage, +25 AS, +200 HP, +3 HP/reg, +90 jangkauan (ranged). Saat HP < 40%: Gale Leap - mundur 130px + +55 AS selama 3 dtk (CD 25 dtk).
gale_pike.desc_en: +18 Damage, +25 AS, +200 HP, +3 HP regen, +90 attack range (ranged). Below 40% HP: Gale Leap - dash back 130px + +55 AS for 3s (25s CD).
gale_pike.flavor: Tombak angin yang mengulur jarak secepat kilat.

basilisk_breath.name: Basilisk Breath
basilisk_breath.desc: +26 Damage, +30 AS, +260 HP, +3 HP/reg. Serangan meracuni: 2.2% Max HP/0.5 dtk selama 3 dtk (maks 60/tick). 30% tembakan menyambar 2 musuh lain (70% dmg).
basilisk_breath.desc_en: +26 Damage, +30 AS, +260 HP, +3 HP regen. Attacks poison: 2.2% Max HP per 0.5s for 3s (cap 60/tick). 30% of shots hit 2 other enemies (70% damage).
basilisk_breath.flavor: Embun racun hydra yang merayap di setiap luka.

solar_brand.name: Solar Brand
solar_brand.desc: +30 Damage, +280 HP, +5 HP/reg. Aura: musuh dalam 280px terbakar 28 dmg/dtk & serangannya 18% lebih sering meleset.
solar_brand.desc_en: +30 Damage, +280 HP, +5 HP regen. Aura: enemies within 280px burn for 28 dmg/s and have 18% more chance to miss.
solar_brand.flavor: Cap matahari yang membakar apa pun yang mendekat.

runic_gavel.name: Runic Gavel
runic_gavel.desc: +28 Damage, +250 HP, +4 HP/reg, 15% CDR. Setiap 9 dtk: serangan berikutnya menambah 130 magic damage ke target (Empower Strike).
runic_gavel.desc_en: +28 Damage, +250 HP, +4 HP regen, 15% CDR. Every 9s your next attack adds 130 magic damage to the target (Empower Strike).
runic_gavel.flavor: Palu runik yang menyimpan muatan sihir tiap hembusan.

searbrand.name: Searbrand
searbrand.desc: +12 Damage, +320 HP, +6 HP/reg, 15% CDR. AURA CAUTERIZE (300px): musuh di dekat HILANG 50% kemampuan heal-nya + bakar 6 dmg/dtk. Saat >=2 musuh dekat: Brand Burst, 110 magic dmg + bakar 22 dmg/dtk selama 3 dtk (CD 18 dtk).
searbrand.desc_en: +12 Damage, +320 HP, +6 HP regen, 15% CDR. CAUTERIZE AURA (300px): nearby enemies LOSE 50% of their healing + take 6 dmg/s burn. When 2+ enemies are near: Brand Burst deals 110 magic dmg and burns 22 dmg/s for 3s (18s CD).
searbrand.flavor: Besi berpijar yang mencauter luka - apa pun yang menerima bekasnya tak akan pernah utuh kembali.

astral_codex.name: Astral Codex
astral_codex.desc: +280 HP, +4 HP/reg, 18% CDR, 12% Spell Lifesteal. SKILL AMP: +25% damage semua skill. Saat >=2 musuh dekat: Arcane Nova, 150 magic dmg + silence 1.5 dtk (CD 24 dtk). HANYA untuk hero beratribut Magic.
astral_codex.desc_en: +280 HP, +4 HP regen, 18% CDR, 12% Spell Lifesteal. SKILL AMP: +25% damage to all skills. When 2+ enemies are near: Arcane Nova, 150 magic dmg + 1.5s silence (24s CD). MAGIC-attribute heroes ONLY.
astral_codex.flavor: Kitab bintang yang halamannya menulis ulang hukum arus sihir setiap kali dibuka.

sage_scepter.name: Sage Scepter
sage_scepter.desc: +200 HP, +3 HP/reg, 15% SKILL AMP, 8% Spell Lifesteal, 8% CDR. Penambat arus sihir murni bagi sang bijak. HANYA hero Magic.
sage_scepter.desc_en: +200 HP, +3 HP regen, 15% SKILL AMP, 8% Spell Lifesteal, 8% CDR. A pure conduit of arcane current for the wise. MAGIC heroes ONLY.
sage_scepter.flavor: Tongkat bijak yang mendengar denyut setiap mantra.

fulgur_scepter.name: Fulgur Scepter
fulgur_scepter.desc: +15 Damage, +200 HP, 10% SKILL AMP, 8% Spell Lifesteal. Saat menyerang (auto): Energy Blast - hantam target dengan 300 magic damage (CD 18 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
fulgur_scepter.desc_en: +15 Damage, +200 HP, 10% SKILL AMP, 8% Spell Lifesteal. When attacking (auto): Energy Blast - slams your target for 300 magic damage (18s CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
fulgur_scepter.flavor: Tongkat petir yang menyimpan satu badai di ujungnya.

hex_idol.name: Hex Idol
hex_idol.desc: +250 HP, +4 HP/reg, 6% Spell Lifesteal, 10% CDR. Saat menyerang (auto): HEX target - stun + silence selama 2.5 dtk (CD 30 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
hex_idol.desc_en: +250 HP, +4 HP regen, 6% Spell Lifesteal, 10% CDR. When attacking (auto): HEX the target - stun + silence for 2.5s (30s CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
hex_idol.flavor: Arca vodu yang mengubah musuh jadi boneka bisu.

rift_veil.name: Rift Veil
rift_veil.desc: +260 HP, +4 HP/reg, 6% Spell Lifesteal. Saat >=2 musuh dekat (auto): Discord Field - musuh dalam 320px menerima +15% damage selama 6 dtk (CD 20 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
rift_veil.desc_en: +260 HP, +4 HP regen, 6% Spell Lifesteal. When 2+ enemies are near (auto): Discord Field - enemies within 320px take +15% damage for 6s (20s CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
rift_veil.flavor: Cadar retakan yang menyingkap sisi rapuh musuh.

vital_stone.name: Vital Stone
vital_stone.desc: +320 HP, +6 HP/reg, 20% Spell Lifesteal. Saat HP < 35% (auto): Vitality Pact - pulihkan 25% Max HP seketika (CD 45 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
vital_stone.desc_en: +320 HP, +6 HP regen, 20% Spell Lifesteal. Below 35% HP (auto): Vitality Pact - instantly restore 25% Max HP (45s CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
vital_stone.flavor: Batu darah yang berdegup menyamai jantung pemakainya.

vine_rod.name: Vine Rod
vine_rod.desc: +15 Damage, +240 HP, +3 HP/reg, 5% Spell Lifesteal. Serangannya men-ROOT target 1 dtk (tak bisa bergerak; CD internal 9 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
vine_rod.desc_en: +15 Damage, +240 HP, +3 HP regen, 5% Spell Lifesteal. Your attacks ROOT the target for 1s (cannot move; 9s internal CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
vine_rod.flavor: Tongkat sulur hidup yang tak pernah melepaskan cengkeramannya.

spectral_charm.name: Spectral Charm
spectral_charm.desc: +230 HP, +3 HP/reg, +10% Move Speed, 6% Spell Lifesteal. Saat HP < 30% (auto): Spectral Form 2.5 dtk - semua serangan FISIK meleset (sihir tetap kena) (CD 25 dtk). HANYA hero Magic.
spectral_charm.desc_en: +230 HP, +3 HP regen, +10% Move Speed, 6% Spell Lifesteal. Below 30% HP (auto): Spectral Form for 2.5s - all PHYSICAL attacks miss (magic still hits) (25s CD). MAGIC heroes ONLY.
spectral_charm.flavor: Jimat kabut yang membuat tubuhmu seketika tanpa wujud.

en.howto_goal_1: Destroy the Dire Nexus (castle) before the Radiant Nexus falls.
en.howto_goal_2: Winning pays meta gold that unlocks heroes in the HERO SHOP.
en.howto_towers_1: Click an empty slot circle (+) on a lane and build a tower (100 gold).
en.howto_towers_2: 4 paths: Archer / Cannon / Ice / Mage. The Lv1→Lv2 upgrade picks the path.
en.howto_heroes_1: You start without heroes. Open H → HERO to buy one you already unlocked.
en.howto_heroes_2: Up to 5 unique heroes. A dead hero respawns after 10 seconds keeping its level and items.
en.howto_heroes_3: Click a Radiant hero to select it, then Q/W/E/R for skills (R = ultimate).
en.howto_heroes_4: Heroes you do not select fight on their own (auto-cast).
en.howto_waves_1: The first wave arrives after 5 seconds. Minions trickle out on all three lanes.
en.howto_waves_2: The next wave waits 25 seconds and for every minion of the old wave to fall.
en.howto_shop_1: 4 tabs: TOWERS / ITEMS / HERO / NEXUS. Items use 6 slots per hero.
en.howto_shop_2: Upgrading the nexus raises its HP and your team's minion scale.
en.howto_progress_1: First win: 3000 meta gold. A winning replay: 1500 (once), then 200.
en.howto_progress_2: A boss defeated plus its castle fallen unlocks that hero for FREE.
en.howto_progress_3: ENTER after a win moves on to the next level (new theme & boss).
en.howto_hard_1: Hard: enemies +15% HP, +10% damage, the Dire castle starts higher.
en.howto_hard_2: Gold income is smaller (x0.75). Easy: x1.25.
